a: BT11-063 [Geremon] and BT15-035 [Geremon] have a rule that also treats them as having the name [Numemon], therefore you can place them as digivolution cards under this Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place a BT11-063 [Geremon] or BT15-035 [Geremon] from my trash in this card's digivolution cards?

Effect: ＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by trashing this Digimon's top stacked card, it isn't deleted.)

[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 level 5 or lower card with [Numemon] in its name or the [Puppet] trait from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck as your top security card.)
